title: Moon Campus Origami Dragon Fold-Off
body: The Interplanetary Origami Guild invites all students to the Origami Dragon Fold-Off on November 18, 2026 from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM at the Low-Gravity Atrium of the Moon Campus. Each entrant gets three sheets of moon-silver paper. Dragons must stay folded for ten minutes without tape. Register at the Guild desk beside the oxygen garden until November 14, 2026.
